name: sidebar-03
title: 工作区树侧栏
description: 图标轨与工作区树双栏侧栏，支持树键盘导航、模块切换、筛选和移动端抽屉。

files.content:
import type * as React from "react"
import type { LucideIcon } from "lucide-react"

type Sidebar03TreeNode = {
  id: string
  label: string
  href?: string
  icon?: LucideIcon
  status?: "active" | "paused" | "archived"
  badge?: string | number
  children?: Sidebar03TreeNode[]
}
type Sidebar03Module = {
  id: string
  label: string
  icon: LucideIcon
  tree: Sidebar03TreeNode[]
  actions?: { id: string; label: string; onSelect: () => void }[]
}
type Sidebar03Usage = {
  label: string
  used: number
  total: number
  unit: string
  href?: string
}
type Sidebar03Navigation = {
  intercept?: boolean
  onNavigate?: (payload: { href: string; nodeId?: string }) => void
}
type Sidebar03Link = React.ElementType
export type {
  Sidebar03TreeNode,
  Sidebar03Module,
  Sidebar03Usage,
  Sidebar03Navigation,
  Sidebar03Link,
}

const DEFAULT_LABELS = {
  brand: "协作空间",
  search: "筛选当前工作区…",
  empty: "没有匹配的节点，请尝试其他关键词。",
  create: "新建",
  more: "更多",
  help: "帮助",
  settings: "设置",
  signOut: "退出",
  upgrade: "升级",
  used: "已用",
  active: "进行中",
  paused: "已暂停",
  archived: "已归档",
  modules: "切换模块",
  tree: "工作区树",
}
type Sidebar03Labels = typeof DEFAULT_LABELS
export { DEFAULT_LABELS }
export type { Sidebar03Labels }
